observation: The source relations are rho^3=sigma^2 and rho^4=sigma^6=1. Their presented group is C2; the copied relation is preserved in all base readers.

locus: Puncture-filling morphism and nonabelian quotient of its kernel
observation: The free profinite group on two generators is explicitly identified on p4. The p17 footnote calls the indicated quotient kernels abelian products of Tate modules.
explicit_verification: Use the open immersion U=P1_Qbar minus{0,1,infinity}->P1_Qbar, with a geometric base point in U. Its induced pi1 map has trivial target: a connected finite étale cover of P1 has 2g-2=-2d by Riemann-Hurwitz, so g=1-d>=0 forces d=1. The kernel is therefore the entire free profinite group on two generators. Sending the generators to(12),(23) gives a continuous surjection to S3. With rightmost permutation acting first, their products are(123) and(132), so the image is nonabelian. Any homomorphic image of a product of abelian Tate modules is abelian. This provides the explicit counterexample to the blanket puncture-kernel description.
